priorityList: Cast Reaver's Glaive to start the Aldrachi cycle if Rending Strike and Glaive Flurry buffs are absent.
Spend Rending Strike and Glaive Flurry stacks immediately using Death Sweep (priority) or Annihilation.
Cast Metamorphosis if Eye Beam is on cooldown and you are not currently in a Demonic window.
Cast Eye Beam on cooldown to enter Demonic, ideally when Blade Dance is nearly ready.
Use Vengeful Retreat to trigger Initiative or Inertia right before your Eye Beam or Essence Break window.
Cast Essence Break while in Metamorphosis, immediately followed by Death Sweep and Annihilation.
Cast Death Sweep / Blade Dance on cooldown as your primary fury spender in AoE.
Cast The Hunt on cooldown, ensuring Essence Break is not active on the target.
Cast Immolation Aura on cooldown to generate Fury and build Ragefire damage.
Cast Fel Rush to trigger the Inertia damage buff when Inertia Ready is active.
Cast Felblade if you need Fury or to stay in melee range, unless pooling for a burst window.
Cast Annihilation or Chaos Strike to dump excess Fury, especially if Essence Break is active.
Cast Throw Glaive as a filler if Soulscar is talented or if you are out of melee range.
Pick up Soul Fragments if Fury is below 40 to avoid resource starvation.
Use Arcane Torrent if you are low on Fury and all other generators are on cooldown.
